description: Texture of ORNAMENTAL BURSTS attached to a composed LINE, with decoration placement FORCED AFTER each line note - the POSTDECOR sibling of the curated texture decorated (which randomly permutes placement per note; source texture4.c:1032-37 GET_DECORNPOS -> vflag[IS_PRE]). All three siblings verified DISTINCT at the same seed (byte-proof in the tranche-18 findings). Same argv and notedata grammar as decorated: line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of each input sound, then '#N' and N rows of 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' - the decorated line; the engine repeats that line every skiptime seconds and hangs a random decoration-group (gpsizlo-gpsizhi events, gppaklo-gppakhi ms apart, spanning gpranglo-gpranghi semitones, amprise/contour-shaped, centring-positioned) on its notes, always AFTER the note in this mode. Pinned to submode 5 ('NONE' - free decoration pitch; modes 1-4 lock to harmonic fields). Banner divergences re-verified in this mode: centring enforced 0-6 ('Parameter[21] Value (7.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 6.000000)') though the banner claims 0-7; position (-p) enforced 0-1 ('Parameter[23] Value (-1.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)') though this banner claims '-1(Left) 1(Right): default 0'. Genuinely stochastic with a WORKING -r seed (-r5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical; -r9 differs). Duration honesty: outdur 5 -> 6.52 (+10.3%), outdur 8 -> 8.89 (+11.1%). Breakpoints: outdur, gpspace, contour, centring and seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/26/30 verbatim); every other numeric positional plus -a/-p/-s accepts (full per-parameter sweep in this mode; skiptime brk exit 0, differ-from-endpoints proof on the decorated sibling). Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO; option flags ORDER-ENFORCED (-a -p -s -r then switches).
musical_use: As texture decorated, but with consistent gesture direction - release-energy: every ornament FALLS AWAY from its line note - after-ring flourishes, bounce-back clusters, echo tails that decay off the beat. Use plain decorated when placement itself should vary. Everything else carries over: keep the line short and let skiptime set the phrase period; gpsizlo/hi and gppaklo/hi shape ornament density and speed; centring 0-6 sits ornaments on/above/below the line pitch; -k keeps only the ornaments (ghost armature); contour 7/8 are the decorated-family directed shapes. Always set a seed to pin a take.

notedata.description: REQUIRED text file (write with write_data_file()): line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of each input sound (single value here); then '#N' and N notelist rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' (times non-decreasing; infile_no 1 with one input; amp is MIDI-style 1-127; dur in seconds) - the line the ornaments decorate. All format refusals are verbatim in the entry description. Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

outdur.description: Requested duration. Actual output overshoots by roughly the line length plus the last ornament's tail (+0.6-0.75 s on a 0.2 s one-note line with small groups: 5 -> 5.71, 8 -> 8.60, 3 -> 3.74) - keep line+ornament small relative to outdur when length matters. Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

skiptime.description: Time between repetitions of the decorated line - the phrase period (family range 0.000002-100). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0, re-verified in this mode; differ-from-endpoints proof on the decorated sibling). LANDMINE (family): a literal 0 slipped the range check and HUNG the binary on the decorated curation fixtures (content-dependent - this mode's probe exited cleanly at 0); keep it positive.

sndfirst.description: First sound to use from the input list (single-input entry: must be 1; 2 refused 'FIRST SND-IN-LIST TO USE > count of files entered: cannot proceed.'). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

sndlast.description: Last sound to use from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

maxdur.description: Maximum event duration (>= mindur; values far beyond the input duration fail obscurely - family finding). Contributes to the duration overshoot. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

phgrid.description: Timegrid in ms applying WITHIN decorations (0 = none). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gpspace.description: Spatialisation of decoration-groups, CDP-enforced 0-5 ('Parameter[11] Value (6.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 5.000000)'): 0 still, 1 scattered (default), 2 towards centre, 3 away, 4/5 follow/counter texture motion. Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 14 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.') - same manual divergence as texture grouped.

amprise.description: Amplitude change within each decoration, CDP-enforced 0-127 ('Parameter[13] Value (128.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 127.000000)'; default 0 = flat). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

contour.description: Amplitude contour of decorations, CDP-enforced 0-8 ('Parameter[14] Value (9.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 8.000000)'): 0 mixed, 1 cresc, 2 flat, 3 decresc, 4-6 combinations, 7 directed_to_event, 8 dir_or_flat (7-8 are decorated-family extras; grouped stops at 6). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 17').

gpsizlo.description: Smallest number of events in a decoration. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gpsizhi.description: Largest number of events in a decoration - with gppakhi this bounds the ornament tail past outdur (family warning: large values inflate the render). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gppaklo.description: Shortest time between event onsets within a decoration, ms (family floor = one sample period, srate-dependent). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gppakhi.description: Longest time between event onsets within a decoration, ms. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gpranglo.description: Minimum pitch range of decorations in semitones (mode 5; hfield-note counts in modes 1-4). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

gpranghi.description: Maximum pitch range of decorations in semitones. Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

centring.description: How decoration pitches centre on the line pitch, ENFORCED 0-6 ('Parameter[21] Value (8.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 6.000000)' - the banner's 'Range 0-7' is WRONG): 0 centred, 1 above, 2 below, 3-6 combinations. Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 26').

atten.description: Overall attenuation multiplier, CDP-enforced 0.000002-1 ('Parameter[22] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.000002 to 1.000000)'). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0). Flag order enforced: -a before -p -s -r.

position.description: Centre of the stereo image - ENFORCED 0-1 ('Parameter[23] Value (-1.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)'; the banner's '-1(Left) 1(Right): default 0' is WRONG on both range and default). Breakpoint-capable (verified with an in-range 0.1->0.9 ramp after an out-of-range brk value refused).

spread.description: Spatial spread of texture events 0-1 ('Parameter[24]' refusal verbatim). Breakpoint-capable (exit 0).

seed.description: Random seed - WORKING (-r5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical in samples AND frame count, sha 58ff4922727fefa3; -r5 vs -r9 differ). 0 (or omission) seeds from the clock. Family range 0-32767. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 30').

whole.description: Play the whole input per event, ignoring mindur/maxdur (verified in this mode: changes render).

fixstep.description: Fixed timestep between decoration notes instead of random gppaklo-gppakhi (verified in this mode: changes render).

instrvary.description: Instruments vary within decorations - multi-input only (family no-op on single input, verified on the decorated sibling).

dectop.description: Decorate the TOP note of line chords (family behavior; no-op without chords, verified on the decorated sibling).

decall.description: Decorate ALL notes of line chords (family behavior; no-op without chords, verified on the decorated sibling).

discardline.description: Discard the original line after decoration - ornaments only (verified in this mode: changes render).

examples.description: Ornamented two-note ostinato with every decoration after its note.

known_issues: Duration honesty (set_by outdur): outdur 5 -> 6.52 (+10.3%), outdur 8 -> 8.89 (+11.1%) on the 0.5 s-ping probe (1 s two-note line, small groups) - overshoot is about the line span plus the last decoration's tail; duration row pinned at outdur 8, tol 0.2, seed 5.

Placement is FORCED AFTER each line note (source texture4.c ISPRE/ISPOST_DECORORN); plain decorated permutes randomly. All three siblings DIFFER at the same seed (byte-proof recorded) - pick this mode for consistent gesture direction.

BANNER ERRORS re-verified in this mode (binary wins): centring 0-6 not the banner's 0-7 (parameter 21 refusal verbatim); position (-p) 0-1 with default 0.5, not the banner's -1..1 default 0 (parameter 23 refusal verbatim). contour genuinely 0-8 (decorated-family 7/8 extras).

Breakpoint surface (full per-parameter sweep in this mode): outdur, gpspace, contour, centring, seed REFUSE (parameters 1/14/17/26/30 verbatim); every other numeric positional plus -a/-p/-s accepts (exit 0).
Option flags ORDER-ENFORCED: -a -p -s -r then switches ('option flag -a out of order on cmdline.' - family).
Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO. Working -r seed; -r0/omission = clock.
skiptime 0: exited cleanly on this probe but HUNG the binary on the decorated-curation fixtures - content-dependent, never map 0 through (curated floor 0.000002).
-i/-h/-e content-dependent no-ops (single input, chord-free line; family finding). Modes 1-4 (harmonic-field decorations) remain execute()-only.
